orgs.name: COMMUNITY ACTION PARTNERSHIP OF LANCASTER COUNTY INC
services: Domestic Violence Services (DVS) — 24/7 hotline and text line (717-299-1249), Safe House emergency shelter, Bridge House transitional apartments and scattered-site transitional housing, and connections to Rapid Rehousing (HUD CoC DVS Bonus TH-RRH projects, $191,435 + $163,210 FY2024 renewals)
Domestic Violence Legal Center — Protection from Abuse filing help, court accompaniment, and attorney consultation/representation in PFA, custody, divorce and support matters
utility assistance and eviction prevention (org program profile); county-wide food distribution and the Crispus Attucks Food Choice Pantry; WIC and early-education programs
orgs.serves: residents of Lancaster County, PA, including domestic-violence survivors and low-income families

orgs.name: ELIZABETHTOWN COMMUNITY HOUSING & OUTREACH SERVICES
services: emergency shelter — low-barrier shelter serving the Elizabethtown-area communities (Elizabethtown, Bainbridge, Rheems, Mount Joy, Marietta, Maytown), with case management (own-site Emergency Shelter Program page)
housing programs and eviction prevention for households facing housing instability (400+ households served annually across Northwest Lancaster County)
permanent supportive housing (HUD CoC 2024 ECHOS PSH Program PA0929, $108,440 FY2024 renewal)
orgs.serves: individuals and families experiencing or at risk of homelessness in Northwest Lancaster County, PA

orgs.name: TENFOLD
services: TLC shelter — 52-room shelter providing housing and wrap-around supportive services for individuals and families experiencing homelessness; winter shelter and Code Blue shelter operations (own-site 2025-26 Winter Shelter Report)
permanent supportive housing (HUD CoC PA-510: Lancaster Hearthside, $219,868 renewal; Market View Apartments, $45,512 renewal)
Beth Shalom program — housing at TLC for mothers exiting prison in Lancaster County, reconnecting with their children and accessing employment and stable housing
housing and financial counseling/coaching (consumer credit, mortgage and pre-purchase counseling) and affordable-housing lending through Tenfold Community Lending
orgs.serves: people experiencing homelessness and housing insecurity in Lancaster County, PA, including families and mothers exiting incarceration
